plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for H3C switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, optical modules, interface traffic, voltage, and power, for S-series Comware (enterprise PEN 25506).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the H3C / HPE Comware device control plane (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtCpuUsage), taken as the maximum across physical entities so the active CPU board's load is reflected rather than diluted by entities that report 0. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_1min
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute CPU utilization of the H3C / HPE Comware device control plane (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtCpuUsageIn1Minute), taken as the maximum across physical entities so the active CPU board's load is reflected.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_5min
metrics.description: This metric reports the five-minute CPU utilization of the H3C / HPE Comware device control plane (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtCpuUsageIn5Minutes), taken as the maximum across physical entities so the active CPU board's load is reflected.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the H3C / HPE Comware device (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtMemUsage, a direct percent value), taken as the maximum across physical entities so the memory-bearing board's usage is reflected. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each H3C / HPE Comware hardware entity (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtTemperature), in degrees Celsius. The 65535 unsupported sentinel is filtered out. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each H3C / HPE Comware cooling fan (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtOperStatus joined with ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalClass fan=7), normalized so that 1 means ok (enabled) and 2 means bad. A non-ok state indicates a cooling fault that can quickly lead to overheating and should be investigated immediately.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each H3C / HPE Comware power supply (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtOperStatus joined with ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalClass powerSupply=6), normalized so that 1 means ok (enabled) and 2 means bad. A non-ok state signals a power redundancy or hardware fault and must be remediated promptly.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: This metric reports the entity voltage of the H3C / HPE Comware device (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtVoltage, millivolts scaled to volts). The 65535 unsupported sentinel is filtered out. Values far from the rated range may indicate unstable power and hardware risk.

metrics.name: device_power_watts
metrics.description: This metric reports current power consumption in watts of H3C / HPE Comware physical entities (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtCurrentPower). It is a consumption reading, not power-supply health; PSU health uses hh3cEntityExtOperStatus with entPhysicalClass powerSupply=6.

metrics.name: device_optical_tx_power
metrics.description: Per-ifIndex SFP/optical transmit power in dBm (HH3C-TRANSCEIVER-INFO-MIB hh3cTransceiverCurTXPower). The device reports 0.01 dBm units; this query scales by 1/100 and drops the 2147483647 unsupported sentinel. An abnormally low TX level indicates a failing laser/optic rather than fiber attenuation alone.

metrics.name: device_optical_rx_power
metrics.description: Per-ifIndex SFP/optical receive power in dBm (HH3C-TRANSCEIVER-INFO-MIB hh3cTransceiverCurRXPower). The device reports 0.01 dBm units; this query scales by 1/100 and drops the 2147483647 unsupported sentinel. A dropping RX level is an early sign of fiber attenuation, dirty optics, or a failing peer transmitter.

metrics.name: device_optical_temperature
metrics.description: Per-ifIndex optical-module temperature in degrees Celsius (HH3C-TRANSCEIVER-INFO-MIB hh3cTransceiverTemperature). The 2147483647 unsupported sentinel is filtered out. Abnormally high module temperature can precede laser degradation or link errors.

metrics.name: device_optical_voltage
metrics.description: Per-ifIndex optical-module supply voltage in volts (HH3C-TRANSCEIVER-INFO-MIB hh3cTransceiverVoltage, 0.01 V units scaled by 1/100). The 2147483647 unsupported sentinel is filtered out. Readings far from the module's rated range can indicate a failing transceiver or host-board power issue.

metrics.name: device_optical_bias
metrics.description: Per-ifIndex optical-module laser bias current in milliamperes (HH3C-TRANSCEIVER-INFO-MIB hh3cTransceiverBiasCurrent, 0.01 mA units scaled by 1/100). The 2147483647 unsupported sentinel is filtered out. Rising bias current at constant TX power is a common aging signal for the laser.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
